home.title: Sal y Sol Sportfishing
home.description: Book your private sport fishing tour in La Paz, BCS.

hero.subtext: Head out on a private boat with your own captain and gear included. Departures every day from Marina La Costa.

about.headline: A local fleet, captains from here
about.body1: We run private sport fishing trips in the Bay of La Paz. Every booking covers the whole boat, so you never share it with strangers.
about.body2: Our captains have known these waters their whole lives and go out daily. You show up at the dock, everything else is ready.

items.q: What is included in the trip?
items.a: Full fishing gear and a cooler with ice. Bait, fishing licence, food and drinks are not included.

items.q: How many people fit on the boat?
items.a: We have two classes: small for up to 3 guests and large for up to 6. The whole boat is yours, never shared. There is no minimum group size and no age restriction.

items.q: What time do we leave and how long is the trip?
items.a: You choose your departure time between 5:00 and 7:00 am when you book. The trip lasts 6 to 8 hours.
At Marina La Costa, Rangel y Navarro, La Paz, BCS, next to Restaurant Marina La Costa. You make your own way to the meeting point.
Pay 100% online, or leave a 30% deposit online and settle the remaining 70% in cash. We accept pesos and dollars.

items.q: What happens if the weather is bad?
items.a: If the captain decides conditions are not safe, we cancel and refund 100% of what you paid.

items.q: Can I change my booking date?
items.a: Yes, with at least 48 hours notice. We move you to the next available slot.

footer.headline: See you at the dock
footer.address: Marina La Costa, Rangel y Navarro

checkout.notice: Once your payment goes through, one of our agents will reach out within the next 24 hours before your trip. Exact location details, transport, references and the captain's name will be provided by our customer care agent.
